title: Irritated, sensitive, and dry skin after just two uses
review: I bought this set of SVR skincare products on Amazon hoping to improve my skin, but unfortunately, it did the opposite. After just two uses, my face and neck became irritated, more sensitive, very dry, and even scratched and uncomfortable.You can see in my photos how my skin looks after using them — tight, red, and unhealthy. I followed the instructions carefully and used only the products shown: the SVR Topialyse cleansing gel, the Hydracid C20 serum, and the Sensifine creams.My skin is usually normal to slightly sensitive, but these products made it much worse rather than better. Very disappointing for products marketed as being suitable for sensitive skin.I wouldn’t recommend these to anyone with even mildly sensitive skin.
